excerpt: Asmi AI is a personal assistant that phones you each morning, takes your to-do list and then calls dentists, restaurants, plumbers or banks to get things done, reporting back by message. Pricing, alternatives and launch comments.
content:
Asmi is an AI personal assistant that makes phone calls for you. Each morning it calls you; you tell it what needs doing, and during the day it rings the services involved, such as a dentist, salon, plumber, bank, insurer or restaurant, or the people you need to coordinate with. It can work through phone menus, wait on hold and handle a back-and-forth conversation, then reports the outcome on iMessage or WhatsApp. You can also send it tasks by chat at any time, including as PDFs, screenshots or voice notes.

On Product Hunt, the makers said Asmi has its own voice, personality and phone number rather than imitating yours, opens every call by saying it is an AI, and only acts when you explicitly ask. They also said it can call several businesses in parallel, remember tasks that span days or weeks, and speak more than 50 languages. Asmi is run by Humint Labs, Inc., a Delaware company, according to its terms. Co-founder and CEO Rishi Raj introduced it on Product Hunt, where it launched on 11 June 2026 and finished #2 for the day with 415 points and 142 comments.

We have not tested Asmi ourselves. This page brings together its official site, its Product Hunt page and the public pages of the products it is compared with, and says where each fact comes from.

profile.summary_short: AI assistant that calls businesses and people for you and reports back by message

fit: have a pile of small errands that need a phone call: bookings, cancellations, quotes, follow-ups
dislike phone calls or long hold times
need calls made in another language, for example while travelling
not_fit: need calls that require you to verify identity live (OTPs, card details): a commenter raised this and the makers said Asmi gathers context first and checks back with you when new information is needed
are uncomfortable with an AI calling businesses on your behalf, even with disclosure
have more than 100 tasks a month: the largest listed plan covers 100

pricing.intro: Asmi gives the first task free, then sells monthly or yearly plans by the number of tasks. Prices are in US dollars and taxes may apply.

plans.name: Pro
plans.detail: 20 tasks a month, or $99 a year. Tasks completed by calls, texts and emails, with reminders and follow-ups

plans.name: Ultra
plans.detail: 100 tasks a month, or $499 a year

notes: Plans can be cancelled any time. The task allowance resets each month.
Product Hunt listed it as free at launch; the site now shows paid plans after the first task.

alternatives.intro: These are products Product Hunt lists as alternatives. Review scores are Product Hunt users' own.

items.name: Pally
items.what: AI personal assistant you text; it remembers, books, chases and calls
items.difference: The closest consumer rival, driven by text and Telegram. Asmi's habit is a daily phone call and real outbound calls.

items.name: Retell AI
items.what: Platform for building AI voice agents and call centres
items.difference: A developer and business platform for voice agents, not a ready-made personal assistant.

items.name: Famulor
items.what: AI voice agent platform for business calls, WhatsApp and SMS
items.starts_at: Free to start; see its pricing page
items.difference: Built for businesses answering and making calls at scale. Asmi works for one person's errands.

alternatives.more: Product Hunt also lists Estera and Dialora.ai, both AI receptionists for businesses.

quotes.author: Marat
quotes.text: I'm wary of giving it so much personal info on addition to the ability to mimic my voice.
quotes.reply: Rishi Raj: Asmi does not mimic your voice; it has its own voice and phone number and introduces itself as your assistant.

quotes.author: Art Stavenka
quotes.text: Tricky thing could be when a bank or salon asks to confirm an OTP or the last 4 of a card mid-call.

quotes.author: Diana Nadim
quotes.text: calling three different insurance providers to compare renewal quotes because the hold times are unbearable.
quotes.reply: Rishi Raj: Asmi can call several vendors in parallel, navigate menus and wait on hold.

x.none: We did not check X for this profile.

faq.a: An AI personal assistant that calls you each morning to collect your tasks, then phones businesses or people to get them done and reports back on iMessage or WhatsApp. It launched on Product Hunt on 11 June 2026.
No. Its makers say it has its own voice, personality and phone number, and every call opens by saying it is an AI.
The first task is free. Pro costs $10 a month for 20 tasks and Ultra $49 a month for 100 tasks, with yearly options at $99 and $499.

faq.q: Can it handle phone menus and hold music?
faq.a: Yes, according to Asmi; it navigates phone menus and waits on hold.
The makers said on Product Hunt it can speak more than 50 languages, chosen by you or from the task's context.
Humint Labs, Inc., a Delaware company, according to Asmi's terms. Rishi Raj is co-founder and CEO.
